purpose: Skills are moving detail into references/*.md. Install copies those files, but get_skill returns only the SKILL.md body and its path, so the agent must read references/x.md itself from the skills root outside its workspace. Does a Kiro agent read it, is the read refused, or does the agent skip it? Scored by script from the stream, see bench/REFERENCES-READ.md.

main.note: origin/main when the study was written; the skill bodies are inline

pr155.note: head of PR 155 (slim dynamodb-design); references/aws-best-practices.md and three more files

asana.note: fold of the Asana skill into sprint-planning (references/asana.md); built on the main commit above, local branch refactor/fold-asana-into-sprint-planning

plantedNote: The primary fact decides usedReference. dynamodb-design: the write-sharding suffix range of 200 (hash(id) % 200), in references/aws-best-practices.md only. sprint-planning: a rollover recreates tasks, so the subtasks and their points are lost and the board shows 22, in references/asana.md only. On origin/main both facts are inline in the skill body.

refs-main.treatment: origin/main as installed, skill bodies inline, skill on demand

refs-main-forced.treatment: refs-main plus the forced-load prefix; shows whether the fact reaches the answer when the body carries it

refs-pr155.treatment: head of PR 155 as installed; the detail moved to references/

refs-pr155-forced.treatment: refs-pr155 plus the forced-load prefix, so the skill reliably loads

refs-asana.treatment: Asana fold as installed; the rollover moved to references/asana.md

refs-readable.treatment: positive control: PR 155 tree, forced load, and an excerpt of the reference inside the workspace at references/aws-best-practices.md (task refs-dynamodb-readable)

creditEstimate.basis: About 3 credits a run for a single-agent document task on this model (earlier runs: k-product-manager alone 2.9, n=6; k-tpm alone 5.1, n=7). The architect is set a little higher because its skill and reference are long.
